subject: 1966 Ford GT40 Mk II manual historical-profile resolution
observation: Automatic historical identification failed to resolve year, class, tire family/context and supplier. After the user manually selected the 1966 World Sportscar / Group 4-6 FAM022 context, construction remained RADIAL from stale/default state even though the intended family was cross-ply/bias-ply.

subject: GT40 generated versus observed pressure closure
interpretation: Current pressure solver remains a failure. Contaminated construction forbids exact coefficient tuning, but does not invalidate the broad pressure-closure regression already reproduced by the clean Escort A/B fixture.

subject: Telemetry distance semantics
observation: GT40 overlay displayed cumulative/session distance around 115 km while the corresponding 25 L CSV covered approximately 48 km between first and last recorded distance-counter values.
calibrationRule: Historical wear calibration must not treat a persistent logger odometer as single-stint distance.

subject: Ford Escort RS1600 FAM023 original generated-pressure run
driverFeedback: car nearly tripped/rolled over the outside tire
interpretation: Original generated cold-pressure prediction failed closure.

subject: Ford Escort RS1600 FAM023 manual pressure-corrected run
interpretation: Corrected cold pressures converged on the generator's approximately 27 psi ideal. The primary original handling failure was cold-pressure prediction, not proof that the historical cross-ply carcass required global stiffening.
prohibitedInferences: Do not globally change FLEX or FLEX_GAIN.
Do not globally change PRESSURE_SPRING_GAIN or PRESSURE_FLEX_GAIN.
Do not globally change SIDEWALL_K_MULT or SIDEWALL_K_MULT_X from the underinflated handling report.

subject: Ford Escort RS1600 FAM023 corrected-pressure thermal response
interpretation: Correcting pressure reduced temperature relative to the underinflated run, consistent with reduced flex/deformation hysteresis heating. Pressure prediction and thermal calibration are separate systems.
prohibitedInference: Do not raise or lower FAM023 targets solely to force telemetry to the current mid-80 C reconstruction prior; do not blindly increase FRICTION_K.

subject: Ford GT40 Mk II FAM022 surface-hot/core-cold thermal observation
requiredRetest: Regenerate a correctly constructed cross-ply FAM022 tire after profile-state and pressure fixes, then retest before tuning Thermal V2.

subject: Escort and GT40 cross-car pressure/thermal conclusion
pressureConclusion: Escort FAM023 confirms generated cold-pressure failure; GT40 FAM022 independently shows severe pressure-closure failure. Global pressure-prediction architecture requires correction.
thermalConclusion: Escort thermal telemetry is valid but absolute history is unresolved. GT40 thermal telemetry is contaminated by radial construction. No global historic-tire thermal multiplier is justified.
requiredOrder: then assess Thermal V2 surface/carcass/core transfer across multiple families
